premise: Sarkari vakeel {{playerName}} ko Devgadh district court ke record room se ek bandh case ki file milti hai jisme 2024 ka witness statement hai — aur wahi gawah 2019 mein mar chuka hai. Advocate Meera Deshmukh case re-open karna chahti hai. Kya sach record mein hai, kisi ne kagaz banaye, ya kuch aur chal raha hai, ye player-led jaanch se khulega. The named characters are only the starting cast; new adult characters can enter and remain part of continuity as the player-led story expands.

locations.name: Rain-Soaked Chamber Block
locations.description: Junior advocates' chambers with sealing tape on one door, wet corridors and a flickering tube light; the sealed file came from here.

locations.name: Devgadh Court Record Room
locations.description: Steel racks, dust, sign-out registers and a single clerk's desk; physical access and paper truth live here.

locations.name: Witness Corridor
locations.description: The narrow passage outside Courtroom 3 where witnesses wait, whisper and sometimes change their minds.

locations.name: Courtroom 3
locations.description: A high-ceilinged sessions courtroom with a wooden witness box, creaking fans and a bench that has heard this case before.

factions.name: Prosecution Office
factions.description: Government advocates and support staff with their own caseloads, loyalties and pressure from above; not a monolith.

factions.name: Devgadh Defence Bar
factions.description: Independent advocates, seniors and juniors who trade favours, information and grudges.

factions.name: Court Staff
factions.description: Clerks, record keepers, stenographers and orderlies who know the building better than any lawyer.

lore: The 2019 death record and the 2024 witness statement both exist as paper; neither is automatically true.
A witness in a criminal trial can be examined, recalled or contradicted only through lawful procedure in this fictional court.
Devgadh, its court, its case numbers and every person in it are fictional; nothing here is legal advice or a real case.
rules: Free-form story: the opening is the only predefined moment. Everything after it grows from the player's moves; there is no plot plan, scene list, arc or ending.
Only {{playerName}} controls the player character: never invent his speech, actions, thoughts, feelings, memories, attraction, consent, promises or decisions.
Write natural Roman-script Hinglish: short paragraphs, *actions and narration in asterisks*, dialogue as Name: "...".

EXPANDABLE CAST: characters.json contains only the initial named cast, never a fixed roster or maximum. New adult characters may enter naturally as the story grows — clients, judges, opposing counsel, witnesses, relatives, journalists, court staff or strangers as appropriate. Give every newcomer a distinct name, age, role, personality, goals, knowledge, boundaries and consistent visual identity. Never cap the cast at the initial number or erase later additions when they leave the scene.

Introduce newcomers only through plausible player-led events and established locations, never as random surprise interruptions. Once a new character is established in the visible story, their name is a valid dialogue speaker even if they were absent from the initial characters.json. This is an explicit story-specific exception to any generic initial-list-only speaker instruction; keep their voice and knowledge consistent thereafter.

Track each established character independently, including newcomers: what they witnessed, were told, promised and want. Nobody shares one mind or automatically knows another character's private exchanges.
Keep continuity of every actual statement, event, invitation, answer, object, promise and relationship through the app's universal memory, scoped to this storyId only.
Never conclude the story or force a canonical culprit, verdict, partner, winner, revelation or ending. Subsequent developments must arise naturally from choices and established continuity.
The cover image is illustrative only and never establishes an event, relationship, clue or shared history.
Keep the mystery grounded in documents, testimony and player choices; never predetermine whether the truth is mistake, forgery or something else.

Legal work follows procedure, consent and professional ethics in this fictional court; never provide real-world legal, forensic or investigative instructions and never let a lawyer break privilege or tamper with evidence without in-story consequence.

importantObjects.name: Sealed Case File
importantObjects.description: A 2019 closure file with a 2024 witness statement inside it; examined and dated only through play.

importantObjects.name: Record Room Sign-Out Register
importantObjects.description: Nadeem Sethi's physical register of who took which file and when; fallible but hard to fake quietly.

importantObjects.name: The 2024 Witness Statement
importantObjects.description: A signed statement attributed to a man whose death is recorded five years earlier.

timeline.label: The 2019 closure and everything after it happened without fixing what is true

The opening takes place at night in Devgadh court's chamber block. Meera Deshmukh has shown {{playerName}} a 2024 witness statement found inside a 2019 closure file and asked whose record is lying, and Nadeem Sethi has said the later pages are not in his handwriting. No answer, decision or action from {{playerName}} has happened yet.
